nodes.question: Why is there a scarcity of comprehensive global overviews of subsidies according to the paragraph?
nodes.answer: There is a scarcity of comprehensive global overviews of subsidies because most organizations concentrate on specific sectors or operate within a limited regional scope.
nodes.paragraph: 2023 ) and the UNEP calculated that, since 2021, the total public energy, agriculture, sheries, and industry, while the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) focuses on subsidies in agriculture, sheries, and forestry (Table S1). However, most of these organizations concentrate on speci C sectorsor operate within a limited regional scope. As a result, efforts to provide a comprehensive, global overview of subsidies remain scarce. In this Perspective paper, we present results of our efforts to compile updated information on subsidies and externalities across six economic sectors directly associ- ated with nature decline (i.e. agriculture, fossil fuel, infrastructures, forestry, sheries-aquaculture, and mineralmining). Our review is based on a thorough compilation of data from secondary and tertiary sources, prioritizing the most comprehensive and up-to-date information availablefor each sector. We draw from a wide range of sources, including peer-reviewed and grey literature, national bud- gets, websites, databases, and other relevant materials(Table S1). To offer a comprehensive view of the relative value of subsidies across sectors, we aggregate data from the various sectors.
